import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text } from 'react-native'

export function Keyboard() {
    return (<View style={{
        width: 300,
        height: 300,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)',
        borderRadius: 20,
        borderWidth: 3,
        borderColor: '#356',
        position: 'absolute',
        flexDirection: 'row',

    }} >

        <View style={{
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center'
        }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#fff' }}>7</Text>
            <Text>8</Text>
            <Text>9</Text>
        </View>

        <View>
            <Text>4</Text>
            <Text>5</Text>
            <Text>6</Text>
        </View>

        <View>
            <Text>1</Text>
            <Text>2</Text>
            <Text>3</Text>
        </View>

    </View>
    )
}
